_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for which GitHub issue is the live Claude Coordination Board. Nothing may hardcode a board number: retiring #6927 required editing 13 references across 6 files, which is why it stayed half-done and two workflows silently certified against a dead board. Resolve through scripts/ci/board_pointer.py. Rotation is ONE edit here plus one new issue -- see docs/claude/coordination-board.md 'Rotating the board'.
_board_state_values: unprovisioned | live | retired -- 'unprovisioned' means NO live board exists and every board-reading check must report could_not_check. check_board_coherence.py REFUSES to let 'unprovisioned' land on main, so a half-finished rotation cannot merge.
_cap_note: GitHub's hard per-issue comment ceiling. Reads keep succeeding past it; only writes 403. That asymmetry is the whole hazard -- see 'stale_after_hours'.
_threshold_note: #6927 averaged 49.9 comments/day over its 50.1-day life (2500 comments, 2026-07-19T09:04:33Z -> 2026-09-07T11:28:17Z). At that rate 2400 leaves ~2 days of headroom to rotate deliberately, and 2000 gives ~10 days of warning. Population: all 2500 comments on #6927, its complete life.
_liveness_note: board-heartbeat.yml WRITES a heartbeat comment every 6h. A write is the only thing that can distinguish a live board from a frozen one -- reads succeed identically on both. Three missed beats (18h) is the death threshold: it tolerates one skipped schedule plus a retry without tolerating a real freeze. #6927 was frozen for 20h before anyone noticed.

previous_boards.retired_because: reached GitHub's hard 2500-comment cap; writes 403 while reads keep returning a permanently frozen board
previous_boards.note: READABLE, NOT WRITABLE. It is the historical record -- do not delete it and do not rewrite its body (8 recorded clobbers). Do not post to it.

last_rotation_reason: Retry of mi-182-successor after board-rotate.yml correctly REFUSED the first attempt: its pre-create placeholder check rejected {{BOARD_ISSUE}}, which by construction cannot be filled until GitHub has assigned the new issue a number. Fresh filename because the result file is the idempotency key and a reused name is a deliberate no-op. Underlying reason unchanged: #6927 reached GitHub's hard 2500-comment cap at 2026-09-07T11:28:17Z; writes 403 while reads keep succeeding against a frozen board. MI-182, operator-approved 2026-09-08.
